en: We can no longer stand by and watch the carnage!  You must end your war with %s2!
The war has gone on long enough!  Make peace with %s2.
%d1%: For Having an Embassy in their Nation.
Advanced Diplomacy adds new diplomatic trading options, from embassies to trading military and worker units.

[H1]Advanced Diplomacy[\\H1][PARAGRAPH:2]Advanced Diplomacy (enabled via the Advanced tactics option) vastly changes the way diplomacy works from standard Civilization. Many new trading options are added, each with their own benefits, and potiential disadvantages. What follows is a list of the new options. (Warning: incomplete)[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Embassies.[\\BOLD] Nations can now establish embassies in other nations. Embassies improve diplomatic relations between countries over time, but be warned; revoking a foreign embassies rights will have disastrous diplomatic repercussions with the other nation. Embassies are now required to unlock higher diplomatic functions with other nations, namely, [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Open Borders Agreements[COLOR_REVERT], [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Defensive Pacts[COLOR_REVERT], and some new options (see below). Requires [LINK=TECH_WRITING]Writing[\\LINK].[PARAGRAPH:2] [BOLD]Right of Passage.[\\BOLD] Similar to open borders, in that it allows foreign trade, but the agreement only allows for defensive units and scouts to pass through the nations. Other units will not be able to enter the territory. Requires [LINK=TECH_WRITING]Writing[\\LINK].[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Free Trade Agreement.[\\BOLD] This agreement increases gold from trading missions and improves diplomatic relations over time. Requires [LINK=TECH_WRITING]Writing[\\LINK] and [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Open borders[COLOR_REVERT].[PARAGRAPH:2] [BOLD]Non-Aggression Pact.[\\BOLD] The AI is somewhat less likely to attack a player with whom it has a non-agression pact. Also improves diplomatic relations over time. Requires [LINK=TECH_WRITING]Writing[\\LINK] and [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Embassy[COLOR_REVERT].[PARAGRAPH:2][BOLD]Trading Military Units and Workers.[\\BOLD] Workers and certain Military units, like siege machines, can be traded. Each tradable unit will be marked in it's respective civilopedia entry with "This unit is tradable." Requires [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Embassy[COLOR_REVERT].
